name: soft_delete_update
comment: A delete on a [SoftDelete] entity (Role) as the dialect sees it: the column-list UPDATE of the flag and the [UpdatedAt] stamp (spec/hooks.md).

expect.sqlite: update roles set is_deleted = @is_deleted, updated_at = @updated_at where id = @id
expect.sqlserver: set nocount on; update [roles] set [is_deleted] = @is_deleted, [updated_at] = @updated_at where [id] = @id; select @@rowcount; set nocount off
